note: Contrast inventory for D3 built via union-over-mechanisms rule across 10 representative vault architectures.

obligations.statement: totalAssets must return total underlying assets managed by vault without reverting.
convertToShares must not revert, must round down towards zero, and must equal previewDeposit if no fees apply.
convertToAssets must not revert, must round down towards zero, and must equal previewRedeem if no fees apply.
maxDeposit must return 0 if deposits are paused or receiver cannot receive shares; must return type(uint256).max if uncapped.
previewDeposit must round down (shares issued) to protect the vault against share inflation.
deposit must emit Deposit event and transfer exact assets from caller, minting previewDeposit amount.
maxMint must return 0 if minting is paused; must return maximum shares that can be minted.
previewMint must round up (assets required) to protect the vault against share dilution.
maxWithdraw must return maximum assets withdrawable by owner considering balance and allowance.
previewWithdraw must round up (shares burned) to prevent vault dilution during asset withdrawal.
withdraw must burn shares from owner, transfer assets to receiver, and check allowance if msg.sender != owner.
maxRedeem must return maximum shares redeemable by owner considering balance and allowance.
previewRedeem must round down (assets delivered) to prevent vault dilution during redemption.
First-depositor donation inflation attack must be mitigated via virtual share/asset offset.
Initial deployment must permanently neutralize exchange rate manipulation via dead shares burned to zero address.
Virtual offset math must not induce precision loss or rounding vulnerabilities for subsequent depositors.
Entry/deposit fee must be deducted from gross asset input before share mint computation.
Exit/redemption fee must be deducted from gross assets before asset payout to receiver.
Accrued management fees must be capped by annualized rate limit to prevent sudden dilution.
Performance fees must only be assessed on net positive profit exceeding high-water mark.
Protocol fee recipient address must not be zero address when fees are minted or transferred.
Fee shares minted must be included in subsequent totalAssets and share dilution math.
When deposits are paused or vault is in emergency shutdown, maxDeposit and maxMint must return 0 and revert.
Emergency shutdown/pause must not prevent owners from redeeming or withdrawing unencumbered assets.
Pause and unpause transitions must be restricted to authorized emergency guardian role.
maxDeposit must return remaining headroom below global vault supply cap rather than type(uint256).max.
Sub-strategy or market-level debt allocation limit must not be breached during deposit routing.
Asynchronous redemption request must lock or escrow shares until fulfillment.
Withdrawal queue ordering must respect FIFO or curator priority without allowing queue jumps.
Oracle pricing used in totalAssets must verify timestamp staleness against maximum delay threshold.
Oracle price feed must reject negative or zero price answers.
Oracle circuit breakers must cap single-block price deviation to prevent flash manipulation.
Vault wrapping rebasing underlying token must query live underlying index/balance rather than cached state.
Downward rebase or negative yield must be socialized proportionally across all shares.
Deposits of fee-on-transfer tokens must measure received balance delta (balanceAfter - balanceBefore).
Minted shares must strictly correspond to actual net received tokens rather than nominal parameter.
Access-controlled deposit must verify depositor is present in KYC/permission allowlist.
Strategy curator or reallocator role changes must observe timelock delay before activation.
deposit / mint must enforce user-specified minimum shares received or maximum assets spent.
withdraw / redeem must enforce user-specified minimum assets received or maximum shares burned.
Fixed-term maturity invariant must lock conversion rate at 1:1 once maturity timestamp is passed.
Flash loan callback must enforce full repayment plus fee before concluding execution.
Reentrancy guard must prevent recursive deposit/withdraw during external token transfer or hook.
Flash minted shares or borrowed assets must be settled within the same transaction.
permit must validate signature against EIP-712 domain separator including chainId and address(this).
permit must reject expired deadlines and ECDSA signatures with malleable high-s or zero address.
Strategy yield harvest must not sandwich user deposits or allow immediate arbitrage of unlocked profits.
Loss socialization from bad debt must decrement totalAssets immediately upon recognition.
